first_public_note: arXiv:2005.05592v1 posted 2020-05-12 (arXiv API); CVPR 2020 (CVF Open Access) IEEE pp. 14421-14430 (CVF PDF numbering 14433-14442), DOI 10.1109/CVPR42600.2020.01444. Both wiki folders hold the same PDF (sha256 f082a81a0b4a2e618f9daf11c4005298eaca3e3cd848e9f803e7f55466ceb4aa). Window: prior before 2019-11, [concurrent] 2019-11 to 2020-11, [later] after 2020-11.
population: One filtered decoder population for all topics (tools/pop.py, 608 unique studies: prior 196, [concurrent] 27, date unresolved 4, [later] 381), including two audio-visual enhancement studies that also run a recogniser, added on reading (isca-deligne02_icslp, arxiv-1904.08248); topic subsets: AVSR 256 (prior 86), LRW 99 (prior 17).

inherited.M01: Ordinary voiced TED / BBC speech video (LRS3-TED, LRW)
inherited.M02: L1 to clean magnitude for the enhancer (Afouras et al. 2018a); character seq2seq cross-entropy
inherited.M03: LRW-pretrained frozen front-end; 0.25-probability babble; length curriculum; Adam halving schedule (Afouras et al. 2018b)
inherited.M04: Noisy voiced speech plus lip video at test
inherited.M05: 16 kHz STFT 40/10 ms, 80 mel bins; 112x112 mouth crop at 25 fps
inherited.M08: 41 decoder outputs stated (26 letters, 10 digits and 4 special tokens listed, which sum to 40); 500 LRW classes
inherited.M11: LRS3-TED and LRW benchmark splits; test partition and speaker overlap not stated
inherited.M13: One P100 GPU, about 15 days of training; no inference cost

topics.inclusion_rule: Published rule kept. For this review: the 86 prior and 9 [concurrent] AVSR decoders of the shared population, classified by full-text pattern (mention counts) for MFCC or filterbank input, any audio enhancement, learned audio-only denoisers, and audio-visual enhancement or separation, then on reading for the target's design (a visually guided enhancement stage whose output feeds an audio-visual recogniser). Boundary: enhancement studies that also run a recogniser are inside (Deligne et al. 2002, Pasa et al. 2019 and Abdelaziz et al. 2013 alike); enhancement scored only with an off-the-shelf recogniser stays outside; versions once; the target excluded.
topics.metric: LRS3 WER under babble at stated SNR (lower)

topics.inclusion_rule: Published rule kept. For this review: the 17 prior and 12 [concurrent] LRW / LRW-1000 word-level decoders of the shared population, classified by full-text pattern for 3D convolution, ResNet, both, I3D or two-stream, pseudo-3D or factorised 3D convolution, and TCN back-ends; pseudo-3D hits read. Boundary: word boundaries used or not is recorded where stated; versions once; the target excluded.

Published rule kept. For this review: the same 86 prior and 9 [concurrent] AVSR decoders, classified by full-text pattern (mention counts) for stated SNR tests, babble noise, SNRs at or below -5 dB, a language-model statement, and run variability or significance (seeds, repeated runs, confidence intervals, plus-minus, significance tests); variability hits read. Boundary: versions once; the target excluded.
